name: Shichirigahama
description: Kamakura's Shonan coast along the Enoden: from Koshigoe's street-running rails past the Kamakurakokomae crossing and Shichirigahama's surf to the cape at Inamuragasaki, with Enoshima and Mount Fuji across Sagami Bay.

water.note: Sagami Bay. The Koshigoe fishing harbour's basin is part of the mapped sea.

waves.note: A typical afternoon south-south-westerly sea breeze over Sagami Bay, with the Pacific swell that makes Shichirigahama a surf beach coming in from the south; chosen values, not a measurement.

water.colour_note: Sagami Bay off Shichirigahama reads a deep blue from the hill and green-grey over the dark volcanic sand near the shore; chosen colours, not measured.

seawall.note: Route 134's sea wall and Koshigoe harbour's quays: concrete.

trees.note: Species are not mapped; the mix is a guess from the Shonan coast's planting: Japanese black pines along Route 134 and the capes, evergreen oaks and camphors on the hills behind, a few palms by the car parks.

game.title: Shichirigahama on Foot
game.blurb: Walk Kamakura's Shonan coast under the real sun: down the hill to the Kamakurakokomae crossing as the Enoden passes, along Shichirigahama's surf, with Enoshima and Mount Fuji across the bay.

travel.name: The Kamakurakokomae crossing 鎌倉高校前1号踏切
Kamakurakokomae Station 鎌倉高校前駅
Koshigoe fishing harbour 腰越漁港
Inamuragasaki cape park 稲村ヶ崎公園

npcs.name: Sato 佐藤
idle: One track, both ways. The trains pass each other at the loops, so if one is late, they all wait.
From this platform you see Enoshima, and on a clear winter morning, Fuji behind it. {time}.

npcs.name: Mio 澪
idle: Every day people stand right here with a camera, waiting for the green train. We just want to get to class.
Wait behind the yellow line when the bell goes. The gates come down fast.

npcs.name: Kai 海
idle: Shichirigahama breaks on a south swell. Small today, but it's still better than the office.
The sand here is dark. Iron in it. They used to make swords from it.

npcs.name: Genzo 源三
idle: Shirasu. Whitebait. We land it in the morning and it's on rice by noon, raw if the sea was kind.
The train runs down the middle of our street. You learn to listen for it.

npcs.name: Yuki 由紀
idle: From this cape the sun sets beside Fuji in winter and into the sea in summer.
Sunset today is at {sunset}. Come back then.

quests.title: Kamakurakokomae
talk: Welcome to Kamakurakokomae. One platform, one track, and the whole of Sagami Bay in front of it.
Everyone asks for the crossing. It's just along the track to the east, where the road comes down the hill. Mio from the high school is usually there. WASD to walk, Shift to run, E to talk.

steps.text: Walk east along the track to the crossing and find Mio

quests.title: The crossing
talk: This is it. The road falls to the sea, the gates, the train, Enoshima behind. Stand up the hill a little and look down.
When the bell starts, stay behind the line and watch the train pass. Then go and see Kai on the beach at Shichirigahama, the next station east.

steps.text: Stand on the hill road above the crossing and look down to the sea
Find Kai on the beach at Shichirigahama

quests.title: Seven ri of sand
talk: Seven ri of beach, they called it. It isn't, but nobody argues with a good name.
Walk east to the cape at Inamuragasaki. Yuki is there every evening with her tripod.

steps.text: Walk to the cape at Inamuragasaki and find Yuki

quests.title: The cape at sunset
talk: Enoshima, and Fuji over its shoulder when the air is clear. This is the picture.
Stay until the sun is down.

steps.text: Be at the cape after sunset

quests.title: Whitebait
talk: You came all the way down to the harbour. Good. Most people only see the train.
Walk up to Koshigoe Station along the street with the rails in it. Mind the train.

steps.text: Walk the street with the rails in it up to Koshigoe Station

game.start_note: You start on the hill road (Nissaka) above the Kamakurakokomae crossing, looking down it to the sea. Your car is parked on the level street to the east: the hill is an 11% grade.
